messages:
Alex: Escalating P1 -> CS. Trial org ClearPath experiencing 502s on embeddings since ~02:00 PST. Support restarted pods; still failing.
Maya: Ack. Paste sample log + last good time?
Alex: Last good 01:58. Log: ```ERROR embed-service upstream 502 model=ada-060 trace=tx-9ab3 err=\"kv cache miss + timeout\"```
Alex: Repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -d '{\"model\":\"ada-060\",\"input\":\"x\"}' -> 502 from prod-pool-A. INF-1142 opened.
infra-bot: [alert] embed-service 5xx spike (prod-pool-A): 90 errors / 5m.
Maya: Sam, can you join for ops + comms? Devon FYI (trial ends in 5 days).
Sam: Ops Q: did support try pool switch? If not, suggest temp route to pool-B and increase KV TTL.
Alex: Not yet. Can perform pool-B switch if CS ok to notify customer.
Devon: If outage >6h mark as renewal-watch. Prep SE intro + 1-week dedicated offer if SLA hit.
Maya: Draft ack to customer (short): "Were investigating intermittent 502s for your trial embeddings. Were routing traffic to alternate capacity now and will update within 1 hour. Maya, Customer Success"
Sam: Playbook: 1) route to pool-B 2) increase KV TTL to 30s for tenant 3) enable verbose traces for 1h 4) monitor 10 consecutive 200s before close.
Alex: Executed pool-B switch at 3301234570. Initial check: 17/20 OK, 3 transient 502s. Monitoring.
infra-bot: [incident-update] INF-1142 mitigation applied (route-switch) at 3301234570.
Maya: Sending ack now and scheduling 30m sync with SE at 14:30 PST.
Devon: Tagged CRM as renewal-watch and created follow-up remedy: postmortem + optional enablement call.
Sam: If errors persist escalate to runtime eng. Closing criteria: <0.5% errors for 30m.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll post RCA draft after metrics stable.
